technology_name: Method for Simultaneous Production and Collection of Micro Liquid Marbles
institution: National Institute of Technology Calicut (NIT Calicut)
problem_solved: Traditional micro-droplet manipulation and capsule fabrication techniques cannot reliably generate ultra-low volume asymmetrical Janus marbles simultaneously with pristine Pickering marbles in a unified, single-step operation.
description: An advanced microfluidic processing method that utilizes an automated micro-tip and an interconnected intersection marble module to seamlessly engineer and collect sub-microliter Janus and Pickering liquid marbles using tailored particle combinations.
applications: Targeted drug delivery micro-capsules, miniaturized gas sensing cells, high-speed ammonia leak detection assays, and multi-compartment micro-bioreactors.
secondary_sector: Biotechnology & Life Sciences, MedTech & Health Care
